watch.summary: A Rocket League streamer confidently claims his aerial play is all part of his plan, only to miss the ball entirely and scream in disbelief.

beats.what: Streamer boasts that his setup is 'all part of the plan'.
He doubles down on his confidence while flying aerial toward the ball.
He whiffs the ball in mid-air.
He screams in agony as he lands without touching the ball.
Streamer expresses utter disbelief at his mistake.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: All part of the plan, baby!
watch.why: The clip relies on classic hubris followed by instant failure. His passionate screaming reaction highlights the comedy in the contrast between his boast and his miss.
